basel_floor.note: the floor binds only on the four notches whose stylised PD is under 5 bp, AA- and above, so it compresses the boom end of the severity axis

failed_calls.note: a failed call leaves its (firm, state, seed) cell one replicate short; it was not retried, so the cell is the median over the replicates that landed. The four unfrozen captures are excluded wholesale, which is why three models carry two replicates rather than five.

flash_real_vs_synth.note: two-sample bootstrap: the arms use different firm batteries, so each is resampled independently and the difference taken inside the draw

frontier_gradient.quantity: rating slope, notches of downgrade per +1 macro-severity step

holm.note: the bootstrap produces intervals; p-values here are a normal approximation from the interval width, used only for the Holm ordering

pd_calibration.quantity: median verbalised one-year PD at each rating notch, against the stylised S&P-anchored ladder in analysis/capital.py

per_model_placebo.quantity: slope on the matched credit-irrelevant placebo axis, notches per step

stable_pd_retention.quantity: log-odds PD slope under 'be stable' divided by the same model's terse slope, recomputed inside each bootstrap draw on the same firms

stable_vs_ttc.quantity: RATING slope under 'be stable' minus the rating slope under the explicit through-the-cycle instruction, in notches per severity step. It is not a PD-retention contrast.

threshold_robustness.criterion: rating-stability interval entirely inside +/-band AND PD retention at or above the threshold

threshold_robustness_stable.criterion: rating-stability interval entirely inside +/-band AND PD retention at or above the threshold

tost.test: two one-sided tests, read off the firm-clustered bootstrap interval of the paired difference: equivalence is declared only if the whole interval lies inside the margin

ttc_rationales.quantity: share of through-the-cycle rationales naming the macro state, by severity state. A model that names the recession while holding its PD flat is anchoring rather than ignoring the cycle.
